free_tier_limits: No permanent free REST API tier. REST API access requires Starter, which has a 15-day trial without a credit card. The free Serverless broker allows 100 connections and 10 GB/month but excludes the REST API.
description: HiveMQ Cloud is a fully managed MQTT platform. Its REST API provides cluster-scoped management of MQTT credentials, permissions, roles, clients, and broker metrics; it does not document provisioning or listing Cloud clusters.
